requirements: R1: The backend service must start successfully without Flyway migration exceptions.
R2: The backup service must execute its backup script without permission denied errors.

slices.title: Fix runtime initialization errors in backend and backup services
slices.jtbd: When implementing initialization fixes for this epic, I want to resolve the Flyway migration failure and the backup script permission error, so that the environment starts successfully.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a fresh deployment environment,
When the docker-compose assembly is launched,
Then the backend service starts successfully without Flyway migration failures.
Given the backup container starts,
When the entrypoint runs the backup script,
Then it executes successfully without permission errors.
Given the fix is applied,
When integration tests verify the environment,
Then the services are healthy and running.
